## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what this change makes possible. Link the work item, requirements, and ADRs.

## Evidence

Record checks actually run and their outcomes, with the relevant behavior/failure scenarios. Distinguish deterministic mocks, real integrations, not-run checks, and inconclusive results. Explain TDD exceptions where applicable; do not add runtime tests for prose-only changes.

## Review and operational impact

Summarize independent review where appropriate, affected authority/storage/recovery contracts, compatibility, and remaining limitations. For release changes, identify the frozen candidate and evidence; this PR template itself does not approve deployment.

## Documentation and follow-ups

Link updated specs, docs, and plan status. List any deliberately deferred work.
